description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: USC and Techstars Accelerator | Techstars Join Us Portfolio Locations I Am... Resources About Techstars Apply Today Home / Techstars Accelerators / USC and Techstars Accelerator ACCELERATORS USC and Techstars Accelerator is an incredible opportunity for innovative pre-seed and seed-stage companies to accelerate their growth rate, make a quantum leap in their business, and tap into the vibrant USC ecosystem. Get in Touch ABOUT THIS PROGRAM The USC and Techstars Accelerator brings together the resources of a leading research university with the power of the Techstars global network to help founders accelerate their growth. This 13-week, in-person program, held on USC's Los Angeles campus, connects startups with experienced mentors from both inside and outside the university while providing access to USC's research, talent, and entrepreneurial ecosystem alongside the Techstars global network. The program is open to startups across all industries, with particular interest in bioscience, engineering, AI, healthcare, deep tech, and media technology. To be eligible, at least one founding team member must be affiliated with USC as a student, alumnus, faculty member, or staff member. Founders affiliated with Keck Medicine of USC and Children's Hospital Los Angeles (CHLA) are also eligible. Inside an Accelerator Aug 24 2026 No application form was opened, and this record does not add a deadline, investment instrument, or eligibility rule beyond that quoted text.
